title: Reading Drill — Assessing small archive boxes — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Assessing small archive boxes — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The records manager in Brackenton received an old report about thicker files bending when stored upright. The report compared the number of damaged folder edges, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the folder inspections rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered eight weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include wear caused by previous storage. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed boxes with adjustable supports as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
